en: A two-image postcard mounted on a white background. The left image shows a stone castle with round towers situated on a small island in a calm lake, viewed from the water with rocks and shoreline in the foreground. The right image shows the castle's interior: a stone hall with vaulted brick ceilings, arched niches, and wooden benches along the walls. At the top of the card are printed and handwritten Finnish words indicating the location and an archive reference.
